summary: Nissan Auto Receivables Company II LLC, as depositor, and Nissan Motor Acceptance Company LLC, as sponsor, disclosed an Underwriting Agreement dated September 22, 2026 with Mizuho Securities USA LLC as representative of underwriters for Nissan Auto Receivables 2026-B Owner Trust notes. The seven classes total $1,285,670,000, registered under Form SF-3, with anticipated closing September 30, 2026. NMAC will transfer retail installment contracts to the depositor under a Purchase Agreement. This is a routine auto-loan ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pool collateral performance and spread pricing.
